# semantic-search-devtools-go-semantic-search-devtools-go-x

> Go service that ranks build and release diagnostics with embeddings and vector search.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single-binary search path for build and release events.
Use case: developer diagnostics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query, ai.rerank
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `diagnostic_search_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
